system.description:
Detects enemies in a radius of 60 feet, provided that the enemies are actually thinking hostile thoughts. Always active when held, does not use charges.

This wand is crafted from dark, smooth wood, featuring a slightly twisted design. At the tip, a striking gem shaped like an eyeball glows with a fiery red hue, while faint, glowing runes spiral along its length.
system.unidentifiedDesc: A slim, smoothly finished stick about 18" (45 cm) long, the wand fits comfortably in one hand. Its surface shows faint runes and hairline veins; one end tapers to a rounded tip while the other terminates in a small carved motif. It feels surprisingly light and balanced.
